seriesTitle: I Became a Legend after My 10 Year-Long Last Stand

episodes.title: When I Returned Home, I'd Become a Hero
episodes.summary: Luck stays behind to fight Demons so his friends can escape, but the battle lasts longer than he anticipates!

episodes.title: There Was a Formidable Foe Deep Inside The Den
episodes.summary: Lock and Sia uncover a vampire plot that suggests the kingdom isn't as safe and peaceful as everyone believes.

episodes.title: She Suspects I'm Her Bastard Brother, And Now We're Going on Her First Adventure
episodes.summary: Lock accompanies Celliss on her first adventure, during which they meet a boy with an unusual companion.

episodes.title: After Ten Years, I'm Even in a Picture Book
episodes.summary: When they find out a vampire high lord is after Gerberga, Lock and friends start planning a counterattack.

episodes.title: After Ten Years, I Was Told to Get Lost
episodes.summary: Once the royal palace comes under attack, Lock decides it's time to take the fight to the vampire high lord.

episodes.title: After Ten Years, I Started a Family
episodes.summary: Lock's life takes some unexpected turns after the battle against the vampire high lord.

episodes.title: The Trespasser and the Secret Passageway
episodes.summary: Lock's new house proves to be full of surprises. Meanwhile, trouble is brewing in the slums.

episodes.title: The Party Is Complete for the First Time in 10 Years
episodes.summary: Lock goes to confront Cavino about Milca, and uncovers a much bigger conspiracy than expected.

episodes.title: Mythical Beasts That Lurk in the Darkness
episodes.summary: Lock and the gang investigate the sewers when Ario and Ginny take too long coming back from a quest.

episodes.title: Storming the Enemy Position
episodes.summary: When mysterious fragments discovered inside the body of a giant sewer rat are assembled, an eerie statue of the "Dark Gods" appears. Lock and his friends become convinced that the Mastafon family is involved, but suddenly, the family's maids, manipulated by "charm," attack Lock's mansion! In the midst of the fierce battle, the Marquis's dog, Tama, delivers a letter to Eric pleading for help. Realizing the gravity of the situation, Lock and Eric rush to the Mastafon mansion!

episodes.title: I Fought for 10 Years, so I Can Easily Defeat Demons
episodes.summary: Locke and Eric storm into the basement of Marquis Mastafon's mansion. While Eric rescues the Marquis and Marquis after a fierce battle with the Vampire Lord, Locke leaps alone into another dimension beyond the mirror to save the Marquis's daughter, Philly! Locke defeats countless vampires and unleashes all his power against the High Lord, who is plotting to summon the "Dark Gods" by sacrificing Philly. However, the High Lord finally opens the door to another world, summoning the demons!
